notes: Clean course: ~67% of flags are component-only sub-glosses (Urdu function words/postpositions like میں, سے, کو, نہیں, وہ and compound-verb stems like کرنا glossed contextually inside larger LEGOs, never drilled bare), and ~19% are legitimate English target morphology (infinitive 'to X'/bare X, article the-X/X, number, subject agreement). The 20 real fixes are almost all drilled USE/build sentence pairs that say the same thing two ways — chiefly a dummy-'it's' inclusion split on '...ضروری ہے', a پسند=like/enjoy split, a بہت=very/so split, دلچسپ=interesting/exciting, ڈر=afraid/worried, and fragment-vs-full clauses; the one real_differentiate is gender-neutral اسے forcing both him/her on one drilled sentence. All low-frequency, so no release blockers.
